reason: Verified in source and by driving. render-b.js:515-519 — the "add" branch does root.querySelector(".b-item") and openEditor(first). Driven at 1440 on owner-flight: focusing the bar button and pressing Enter leaves .b-item count at 7, opens the editor bound to data-id demo-audience-item-menu, and fills #b-edit-title with "Menu tasting at The Orchard"; focus stays on the button; the only live regions on the page are the step readout and the undo bar, neither of which says anything. So the distinct claim this seat makes is correct on its central point: this is not a control that does nothing, it is a control whose label promises creation and whose behaviour is to open an editor on an unrelated existing moment, with no announcement of what happened. That is worse than inert and automation cannot see it — the dead-control gate only asks for a data-act, and "add" has one. Two parts of the finding are wrong and must not survive into the fix brief. (1) The stated harm is false: nothing is renamed. #b-edit-title has no input or commit handler anywhere, and closeEditor only removes the node, so typing "A brand new thing" and pressing Done left the first row reading "Menu tasting at The Orchard" and the count at 7. The owner's typing is discarded, not applied — a different and more visible failure than a silent rename. (2) The severity label is an overstatement. lessons.md defines the worst keyboard class as unrelated, unannounced AND irreversible; this is unrelated and unannounced but commits no state at all, and Escape closes it clean. Call it a lying primary verb, not the worst class. The claimed "stated rule that anything not built has no button element" is also not in lock.md, DIRECTIONS.md, brief.md or REFERENCE.md — the real precedent is in code, inert("Nothing to preview yet") in owner-empty. Confirmed on the mechanism, discounted on the harm and the grade.
sharpenedFix: The fix as written aims at the right branch but would crash and would strand the owner, because it assumes an editor that does not exist. Three corrections. (a) The editor is fixture-backed: editor(), setAway() and setVisibility() all call recordFor(item.getAttribute("data-id")) and read record.title. A row with data-id "new-"+Date.now() returns undefined and throws on the first paint of the panel and on every step press. Either push a synthetic record {id, title:"", date, ...} into F.milestones when the row is created, or change recordFor to fall back to a record read off the DOM row (title from .b-title, date from data-date). Do this first; nothing else in the fix works without it. (b) Build the title commit at the same time. #b-edit-title currently writes nowhere, so a new row named by the owner would stay "Untitled moment" permanently — a worse outcome than today's. Wire an input listener that writes the value into the row's .b-title, refreshes the .b-grab aria-label through grabLabel, and falls back to "Untitled moment" when empty. (c) The undo model only knows day-moves: undo() pops {id,title,from,to} and calls setAway(last.from). Recording "A new moment was added." needs a kind on the history entry ({kind:"add"} removing the row and calling place(), {kind:"move"} as today), or Ctrl+Z will call setAway with undefined. Keep the rest of the proposal as written: append to .b-measure, call place(measureEl), openEditor, focus #b-edit-title empty with placeholder "What is happening", and gate-assert that pressing Add raises the .b-item count by one and leaves #b-edit-title empty and focused. Also announce it — put "A new moment was added." through the existing .b-undo role=status so the change is spoken, since the current defect is as much silence as it is misdirection. If it is not built this round, the interim is inert("Add a moment") exactly as owner-empty does, not an aria-disabled button.
